description.value:
The next time before the power ends that you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 1d6 cold damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or gain 1 slowed level for the duration. At the start of each of its turns thereafter, it may repeat the saving throw, ending the slow on itself on a success.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra cold damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.
